newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in slow late trading on Monday due to sufficient rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
"The rupiah remained little changed because of sufficient liquidity," one Japanese bank dealer said.

The dealer said trading was generally slow as players preferred to stay on the sidelines, but said the market was likely to be more active in the coming days due to the month-end factor and half-year book closing.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2430.25/30.75 at 1010 GMT against an opening of 2429.00/30.00.
Dealers said the market remained concerned that the Thai problems could spill over to Indonesia, sustaining their overborrowing strategy.
They said Indonesian rupiah was a possible target but by past performance, such as during the baht crisis in May, the rupiah currency was reasonably safe.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,430.00/30.45 and 2,430.25/30.50, respectively. Overnight swaps were at 0.30/0.40 and tom/next at 0.33/0.35 points.
Overnight money was down at around the 5.0/6.0 percent level in late trading from around 12.0/13.0 percent in early trade due to the sufficient rupiah liquidity, another bank dealer said.
One-month swaps were at 14.00/14.50, two at 27.50/29.50, three at 42.50/44.00 and six at 84.00/85.75 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,424/2,616 and its conversion band at 2,424/2,472 on Monday.
